decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a low-cost consumer option with uncertain but still unresolved prospects, so keeping it open costs little even though it sits far from the firm's engineering core.
Modular extensions to existing waste-to-energy plants build directly on established offerings and cost little to keep on the market, preserving upside as demand for decentralized energy develops.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own dedicated page, signaling commitment and early positive resolution of uncertainty, so continued investment is justified.
Plastic-to-fuel remains highly uncertain but strategically valuable, and as a mentioned, low-maintenance offering it is worth holding as an option until market results clarify its value.
